title: Promotions
description: Manage featured and sponsored listing promotions.

help.title: About promotions
help.overview: A promotion puts one of your listings first in the recommended list, as featured or sponsored, between a start and an end date.

sections.title: Each promotion
items: You can promote your own active listings.
Pause stops it for a while; Resume restarts it while the end date is still ahead.
Stop permanently ends it for good, with a reason.
Promoted listings come first, newest promotion first, then the rest.
